title: Price all 510 collective BIT owner-release profiles
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Each of the 510 projected profiles formed by the nonempty subsets of eight grade-seven families, with and without the port-89/helper-660 release, creates one new chart-1 stock relation per selected family. Chart 0 has zero sensitivity. Even free favorable grade-seven returns leave every affected 36-call BIT profile worse at κ = 0.00388. Both emitted 675-owner words reproduce the forward and adjoint operators while keeping owner 411. They have identical signed profiles, including the word with a mixed return basis and an actual decoding ADD.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Compare the fixed-stock and rebuilt-geometry predecessors [#7953](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7953) at `13a47f662901e894fee93365c7efec89f4f21fae`, [#7979](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7979) at `5a0a5c252cc05a246a557ff18b63e9f23400eff9`, [#7983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7983) at `5f393bfc838276228ff8adfee9c5625d8ce9197f`, [#7984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7984) at `e1dd7de81018f3eda71dad83ab72bab6e8faeb9e`, the changed terminal tests [#7985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7985) at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc`, and the native and signed baseline [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`.

## Validation

In a clean Python 3.12 extraction check `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-ROUND8` and run the replay commands in `ROUND8-REPORT.md`. The raw-tape audit reproduced all 510 projected masks and prices. The two literal operators, protected helper and corrupted-return controls passed as documented.

## Open next questions

Change retained sender equations outside the existing source-only injections, or supply a different productive incidence. Physical dirty retirement, precision and the finite consumer need separate proof.
